headline: Blues activate Logan Mailloux from IR for season debut
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Blues have activated Logan Mailloux from injured reserve for his season debut. He had been out since undergoing hand surgery in September.

St. Louis is 7-8-2 through 17 games, and our numbers say the record is a fair read. The Blues have created 48 percent of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality, based on where and how shots are taken) so far this season, and the same 48 percent at five-on-five, so they are being outplayed a little but not badly. The bigger issue is finishing: they sit 1.8 goals below what their chances should have produced, and only a goaltending bump of 3.1 goals saved above expected has kept the standings respectable. The special teams are close to neutral, with a power play generating 0.54 expected goals per game and a penalty kill allowing 0.58. We have no individual numbers on Mailloux yet, so the question is whether he can tilt that five-on-five share back above 50 percent. A team leaning on its goalie to cover for a quiet offense doesn't have much margin to spare.
